body:
The Tasks tab pages at 25 (task:fa381a3d2079fb08); make the page size 10. Keep the existing filter-before-paging order, the reset to page 1 when a filter changes, the Prev/Next disabled states, the `page N of M, T tasks` count, and a selected task's details across page changes.

**Tests:** paging for 0, 1, 10, 11, 25 and 26 matching tasks; first and last page controls; a filter change returns to page 1; a live update that shrinks the list never leaves an empty page.
title: tasks: page ten at a time
